configuration.ports_axis: 1UE,1cell,20MHz; raw symmetric radio port matrix, not NR rank/layers

definitions.progress: Completed IQ samples / (nominal sample rate × measured wall duration), worst RX port/node. Not success/attempt counts.
definitions.cadence_coverage: Expected publications minus one finite-window boundary batch (one batch can straddle the window edge); exact ratios are retained.
definitions.deadline_misses: IQ late completion or radio pacer rebase/call exceeding its batch budget, reported separately. Cadence coverage does not imply zero deadline misses.
definitions.transition: Repeated-run turnover region under the stated hardware/CPU/model/window; mixed results are not a hard maximum.

limitations: Synthetic ZMQ peers do not execute OCUDU radio_zmq or srsUE RF/PHY/MAC; live-stack validation remains the earlier, separately indexed experiment.
Static TDL isolation workload differs from the live moving Sionna control replay.
CPU masks allow execution on those cores; cores were not reserved from OS/desktop/background tasks.
Different host architectures, peer CPU pools,drivers and automatic GPU host-memory routes; not an isolated GPU-silicon comparison.
No device-kernel or scheduler-stack causal attribution is claimed from process call/wait-region wall times.
